title: Adopt common runtime in desktop Gallery
requires: Linux or Windows desktop with one Gallery backend
scope: Replace the desktop-private GallerySession/GalleryRuntime path with the shared runtime while retaining backend selection, overlays, capture and calibration clients.
acceptance: Interactive, headless, replay and benchmark paths use the common runtime for scene lifecycle and controls.
Existing supported desktop scene, input, rendering and calibration suites pass without parallel legacy lifecycle code.
evidence: PASS: cmake --build build-desktop-switch -j1; Linux Release build completed 72/72 targets.

PASS: physical Vulkan CTest #38 Gallery session contract plus #39-42 Cloth/ClothTear/ClothPaint/ClothWater; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU; common selection/reset/action/parameter contract and scene paths.

PASS: ./scripts/Run-DesktopGallery.sh --backend cuda --constraint-point --frames 3 --constraint-action-after-frames 1 --headless /tmp/f7-06-cuda.ppm; CUDA rendered on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU.

PASS: ./scripts/Run-DesktopGallery.sh --backend vulkan --constraint-point --frames 3 --constraint-action-after-frames 1 --frame-timings /tmp/f7-06-vulkan.csv --headless /tmp/f7-06-vulkan.ppm; Vulkan rendered and recorded timings on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU.

PASS: command Gallery, Gallery scene, workload, deployment, frame timing/overlay, camera, frame budget/policy, registry and input tests (11 relevant tests); BASELINE: unchanged device-profile target still fails quiet-wall stability on CUDA and Vulkan and links none of the modified F7-06 modules.

history.reason: Desktop interactive, headless and calibration clients now use GallerySession for lifecycle, controls, camera and revision tracking; the private DesktopGalleryState/build_runtime path is removed.
